note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Missed a THIRD deadline: the leaked Jul 17 GA date passed with no card, benchmarks or price, and Google is reportedly weighing a stopgap release amid a senior-DeepMind talent exodus. Polymarket's 'new Gemini reasoning flagship by Jul 31' still prices a release near ~71-77%, but roughly 1-in-4 traders now expect nothing by month-end.

Polymarket's 'GPT-6 released by' market cooled to ~68% by Dec 31 and only ~39% by Sep 30; OpenAI's line still runs through the GPT-5.6 family (Sol/Terra/Luna public Jul 9), keeping the numbered flagship a Q4 story.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus at ~96% by Oct 31, though the exact version is unannounced.
xAI shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; Manifold prices Grok 5 at ~43% before Sep 2026. The 6T V9-foundation model is reportedly still training on Colossus 2, with full API access possibly slipping to Q3+.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is pending, with a reported Jul 24 developer deadline now days away.
